text:
incident-bot: ALERT — region=us-west1 primary-gpu-pool at 99% utilization, request-queue length > 12k, autoscaler hitting scale_limit. Paging @sre_oncall :rotating_light:

sre_oncall: acknowledging. seeing sustained token-rate spike from a single customer batch. autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts failing with 'quota_exceeded' and then a 30s cooldown.

eva: rolling in. queue metric: `avg_pending_per_second = 2100`, `99th_latency = 4.3s`. Primary pool eviction spike + throttles. Any recent deploys to routing?

mike: deploybot shows a routing change ~2539989950 — spillover_cooldown set from 45s -> 15s to reduce failover delay. Could cause oscillation on cross-region redirect.

sre_oncall: that would explain thrash. If cooldown too short, requests bounce between us-west1 and us-east1 while both approach saturation. Can we revert to previous cooldown ASAP?

deploybot: I can roll back the routing flag on the control plane. Running: `curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/flags/spillover_cooldown -d '{"value":45}'` -> 202 ACCEPTED.

ops_lead: hold on rollback — need to coordinate with autoscaler team. If we increase cooldown too much, primary could stay saturated longer and customers will see higher latency. Options: 1) revert cooldown AND throttle spillover percentage to 10%; 2) temporarily increase dedicated capacity in us-west1 (burst), or 3) route heavier traffic to secondary cold pool with higher latencies. Thoughts?

sre_oncall: recommend 1 + 3: revert to 45s and set spillover_percent=10, then spin up emergency burst nodes in us-west1. Spinning up nodes currently blocked by quota_exceeded — need infra quota bump. @mike can you request burst capacity?

mike: already on it — opened infra ticket INF-4893 to get temporary GPU quota increase. ETA ~ 12m. In meantime I can increase spillover_percent to 15% as a stopgap. Applying change.

deploybot: Applying `spillover_percent=15` -> ok. Reverting cooldown to 45s -> ok.

auto-scaler-bot: Autoscaler: attempted scale from 120 -> 160 nodes at 2539990012; cloud API returned `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` for GPUs. Next retry scheduled 60s.

sre_oncall: note: autoscaler retries have an exponential backoff; combined with short spillover cooldown earlier caused repeated oscillation. After rollout revert we should see queue draining as fewer reroutes.

cs_ops: ping — any indication of customer impact? Which customers hit error 429/503? We should prepare comms for top 5 paying tenants.

sre_oncall: querying logs for 429 spikes. Found elevated 429s for tenant: "acme-payments" between 2539989980-2539990020; approx 6% of their requests saw 5xx/429. Noting severity P1-customer-impact.

ops_lead: CS, notify Acme CS contact and offer mitigation: enable their traffic pin to east1 where capacity looks healthy. Also prepare post-incident note.

cs_ops: contacting Acme now. Draft message: "We observed elevated latency and throttling in us-west1 resulting in intermittent failures; we've rerouted portion of your traffic and are provisioning capacity. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline."

sre_oncall: monitoring: queue length dropped from 12.2k -> 4.5k in 8m after changes; 99th latency down to 2.1s. No new scale failures after revert.

mike: infra confirmed temporary quota bump granted at 2539990048, starting node spin-up. New nodes starting, expected ready in 6m.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — status=mitigated, impact=partial, affected_customers=["acme-payments"], mitigation=rollback_flag + spillover throttle + emergency quota.

sre_oncall: recommend keeping this thread open until new nodes fully join and all queues < 500. Action items: 1) postmortem on spillover_cooldown change (owner: mike), 2) autoscaler retry/backoff tuning (owner: eva), 3) run chaos test for routing oscillation (owner: ops_lead).

ops_lead: agreed. Also add runbook update: if autoscaler returns RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, pause cross-region reroutes for 2m and enable spillover throttling.

cs_ops: Acme responded: "Thanks, we saw the drop in errors, appreciate the quick action." They're asking for a short RCA once done.

sre_oncall: last check: queue 380, 99th latency 0.9s. Marking incident resolved to routing mitigation, leaving open follow-ups. Closing pager.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — resolved_by=sre_oncall, resolved_ts=2539990065, severity=SEV-3, followup=["INF-4893","RFC-2026-routing-spillover"]

mike: quick note for postmortem: the config change went through a self-serve flag with no safety gate. I'll add a mandatory canary and a 10m cooldown for routing flags.

eva: will open autoscaler tuning PR with default backoff floor and explicit `scale_limit` alerts.

ops_lead: thanks team. I'll schedule 1hr blameless postmortem tomorrow AM.

[reactions: :thumbsup: from cs_ops, :eyes: from deploybot]
